summary: tkitchen v1 (git first) planned through pick-flow -> draft-plan -> verify-plan -> grill -> to-prd -> to-issues. A resident Node 22.19+ process per machine (started at sign-in) runs a Round per configured repo every 15 min: ls-remote + gh PR list, automatic base detection (config override -> open PR target -> creation reflog -> reflog tip -> needs_base/ambiguous), a Base moved Trigger when a base with children moves, and a branch_state table that `tkitchen notices` reads. Export `tkitchen.export/1` for aiNho. DDD layers, DST as the main test layer, and tstack's oxlint rules (snapshot bfa26c76) copied from tstack. 10 issues: 9 AFK, 1 HITL; issue 01 is the walking skeleton.
